app.title: Sell Price Calculator
app.subtitle: Calculate the optimal selling price for your food menu

landing.heroSubtitle: Transform your menu from a best guess into a precision-engineered profit engine. Calculate food costs, overheads, and target margins in seconds.
landing.problemSubtitle: Running a kitchen on a feeling leads to invisible losses. Precision pricing turns your passion into a sustainable business.
landing.problemCard1Item1: Copying prices from competitors without knowing your actual costs.
landing.problemCard1Item2: Ignoring hidden overheads like gas, labor, and electricity.
landing.problemCard1Item3: Losing money on high-cost ingredients because of stagnant pricing.
landing.problemCard2Item1: Live ingredient cost tracking synced with market trends.
landing.problemCard2Item2: Automated overhead calculations for every single plate.
landing.problemCard2Item3: Strategic pricing models based on your specific profit goals.
landing.featuresSubtitle: We provide the scientific tools to price your menu according to your business strategy, not just the market average.
landing.feature1Desc: Calculate price based on your ideal target cost percentage (e.g., 25% or 30%). Perfect for standard restaurant models.
landing.feature2Desc: Apply a fixed multiplier to your raw ingredient costs. Ideal for bakeries, catering, and volume-heavy operations.
landing.feature3Desc: Compare your costs against local market averages and adjust your premium positioning accordingly.
landing.howTitle: Your journey to precision in 4 steps
landing.howStep1Desc: Enter your recipes and latest supplier prices.
landing.howStep2Desc: Factor in labor, utilities, and packaging costs.
landing.howStep3Desc: Select a pricing model that fits your goals.
landing.howStep4Desc: Get your final price and watch your business grow.
landing.testimonialTitle: Built for home-cooks and professional caterers alike.
landing.testimonialQuote: Before ChefCost, I was essentially guessing my prices for my weekend catering business. I realized I was barely breaking even on my most popular cake! Now I have total clarity and my monthly profit has increased by 40%.
landing.stat1Label: Average profit increase in first 3 months
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your kitchen's future?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of chefs who have ditched the guesswork for precision costing.
landing.footerTagline: Precision for every plate. The ultimate menu costing tool for modern culinary entrepreneurs.
